But more, the nature of underwater environment has its own challenges like high latency, low bandwidth, and energy constraint (energy starvation) which makes us to investigate routes in manner that ensures reliable as well as energy efficient data collection. Thus, we have presented an Efficient Adjustable Routing Path for Data Collection (EARP-DC), it is designed to enhance data dissemination among UWSNs. To take dynamic network conditions into account our EARP-DC algorithm is used so to suit the real-time routing paths. It aims at minimizing the network delay and energy consumption while maximizing packet delivery ratio, throughput coupled with lower data packet loss. EARP-DC uses a multimeric attribute choice method to find the best route, considering various performance parameters. It eventually enhances the overall performance of the network. Extensive simulations show that EARP-DC outperforms existing routing protocols in UWSNs. Results show a significant reduction in network delay and energy use as well as increased packet delivery ratio and throughput. In addition, the algorithm has more efficient data packet loss rates which mean that data transmission underwater can still be reliable even when conditions are difficult. This paper puts special emphasis on while another research. The future of UWSN data collection will be efficiency and dependability. By using such networks need less energy and are more robust.

articleTitle: Self-Aware AI-Based Anomaly Detection for AI IoT Enabled Smart Healthcare System
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Computing and Information Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) based smart healthcare systems can significantly enhance the quality of patient care. These systems can enable healthcare providers to monitor patient conditions in real time. IoT-based smart healthcare systems have the potential to revolutionize the way we provide care. Anomaly detection is crucial in IoT-based smart healthcare systems due to numerous reasons. It plays a dominant role in proactive health-care analysis, especially in brain diseases. In brain Magnetic Res-onance Imaging (MRI), anomaly detection helps in identifying several abnormalities, such as cysts, strokes, infections, vascular and developmental malformations, and neurological disorders like Alzheimer's and multiple sclerosis. The existing approaches of brain MRI anomaly detection, and anomaly detection in IoT-based smart healthcare systems utilizes static AI models. Conventional AI based models can be trained once and cannot tackle the changes in real time. The population health and the nature of disease consistently change, and conventional AI based models can't adapt to those changes. Conventional AI based system cannot tackle the changes caused by variations like diseases and public health and become ineffective over the time. Self-aware AI models can address these issues as they can learn and adapt to their environment. Self-aware AI-based systems have the potential to change lives through their ability to learn, adapt, and improve over time. In this paper, we proposed a novel approach to anomaly detection based on self-aware AI in IoT-based smart healthcare systems. Additionally, an algorithm for anomaly detection in MRI images, namely Self-Aware AI based Anomaly Detection (SAAD) is proposed. Our proposed system can detect anomalies in brain MRI images. We achieved 98% accuracy and 0.99 precision and recall, outperforming the existing approaches. The proposed self-aware AI based anomaly detection framework for IoT-based smart healthcare systems has the potential to revolutionize healthcare.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Driven Decentralization for Data Sharing in the Metaverse
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Computing and Information Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: This paper presents a novel decentralized architecture that aims to transform the metaverse by smoothly incorporating blockchain technology. The proposed framework promotes decentralization principles to address centralization issues and restrict user empowerment in existing metaverse systems. It prioritizes putting people at the centre of their digital experiences. The decentralized framework goes beyond traditional tokenization methods by adding extra layers, like non-fungible tokens (NFTs) that change who owns an asset, and decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs) that give people in communities more power, thereby fostering creativity and inclusion in virtual environments. Built upon the fundamental concepts of decentralization and user-centric design, the framework tackles the existing limits of the metaverse and envisions a future in which people actively define their virtual destiny. In addition to addressing issues, the framework provides possibilities for cooperative advancement, decentralized exchange of information, incorporation of future technology, and market growth, acting as a catalyst for innovation within the developing metaverse ecosystem. The framework embodies not only a framework but also a vision for a decentralized and user-centric metaverse, fostering creativity, inclusion, and the realization of virtual aspirations.

articleTitle: Enhanced Diabetes Prediction Through Advanced Machine Learning and Imbalance Handling Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Computing and Information Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of various machine learning classifiers for diabetes prediction, with a specific focus on addressing the challenges posed by imbalanced datasets. The study evaluates the effectiveness of three popular imbalance handling techniques, Adaptive Synthetic (ADASYN), Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE), and Random Under-Sampling, when applied to different classifiers, including Gradient Boosting, Decision Tree, K-Nearest Neighbors, and Logistic Regression. Through extensive experimentation on the PIMA Indians Diabetes Dataset and the Diabetes Dataset 2019, the proposed methodology integrates advanced feature engineering and robust imbalance handling to enhance prediction accuracy. The results demonstrate that the Gradient Boosting classifier, particularly when combined with the ADASYN technique, consistently outperforms other models across all evaluation metrics, achieving state-of-the-art performance. This study not only highlights the importance of selecting appropriate imbalance handling methods but also provides practical insights into the strengths and limitations of different classifiers in the context of medical data classification. The findings are further supported by visualizations such as ROC curves, precision-recall curves, and confusion matrices, offering a detailed understanding of model behavior. This research contributes to the development of more accurate and reliable predictive models for diabetes, with potential applications in broader medical data analysis.

articleTitle: Fixed Frequency Sliding Mode Control for Parallel Linked Distributed Generators in the Isolated AC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Computing and Information Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Parallel linked inverter-interfaced distributed generators (DGs) have been utilized to increase the power capacity and system reliability and maintain the power supply at the critical load end. However, the control methods are crucial for ensuring a stable output voltage from the DGs. In this paper, the authors have proposed parallel linked inverter-interface DGs based on a voltage control strategy in an isolated AC microgrid (MG). Each three-phase parallel DG consists of an inductor-capacitor (LC) filter at the output and is connected to the AC distribution bus (DB) to meet the critical load demand. Fixed frequency sliding mode control (FFSMC) regulates the voltage at the output under steady-state, linear, nonlinear, and unbalanced load conditions. The constant switching frequency-based control design is employed, and the chattering phenomenon is diminished by smoothing the control law in a boundary layer. The proposed FFSMC provides stability against severe variations of load as well. The droop control method and virtual output impedance (VOI) loop are examined to ensure active and reactive power sharing between the parallel-linked DGs. The implementation of the FFSMC has been evaluated in a MATLAB/Simulink environment through simulations. The simulation outcomes reveal the efficiency of FFSMC in terms of quick response time, superior robustness, stable performance, and a low total harmonic distortion (THD).

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Hotel Customers' Feedback in Bangla Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Computing and Information Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: In the rapidly expanding internet era, customers or tourists can easily find information about hotels. The growth of the hospitality industry in Bangladesh has led to a rise in the number of online hotel reviews. In this respect, it becomes a concern to understand the customer experience and review the quality level of hotels relying on their services. Sentiment analysis is one of the intimate extents of text mining, where digital text-based consumer responses or emotions are reviewed using machine learning methods. The purpose of this study is to construct a benchmark dataset of hotel customers' feedback in Bangla and preprocess the data for sentiment analysis using natural language processing techniques. In accordance with this, it has proposed a machine learning method to accomplish sentiment analysis on Bangla text-based hotel reviews. It has been employed a set of machine learning algorithms like Decision Tree (DT), Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machines (SVM), and Naive Bayes (NB) to explore the accuracy of Bangla text data regarding customer feedback. These algorithms classify the reviews as positive, negative, or neutral. This study performs these algorithms and finds the consequences of machine learning models in terms of accuracy. However, the proposed analysis from these algorithms shows that RF provides the highest accuracy of 83% for sentiment analysis tasks. These findings suggest that combining machine learning techniques can be an effective way to analyze Bangla text-based hotel customers' feedback and provide valuable insights for the hospitality industry in Bangladesh.

articleTitle: Detection of Abusive Tweets Using Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Computing and Information Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Twitter (X) is one of the most popular social networks in the Arab region, ranked tenth among social media applications in attracting visitors. The diversity of users and their varying interests has led to the presence of spammers posting offensive and harmful content to Twitter (X) users. This paper focuses on detecting spam messages written in Arabic. The Arabic language is based on consistent roots: past, present, and imperative. The proposed method for detecting abusive tweets employs the Support Vector Machine (SVM) to extract features. The results of Recall, Precision, F-measure, and Accuracy are used to evaluate the method's performance. In the best case, the Recall achieved is 0.995.

articleTitle: Metaverse Empowered Healthcare 5.0 in B5G: Use Cases, Opportunities and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2025 4th International Conference on Computing and Information Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Patient tracking on the go, emotional telemedicine, telesurgery, wellness tracking, virtual clinics, and customized treatment are all made possible by Healthcare 5.0. Healthcare services offered by metaverse have the potential to transform the sector entirely, and the development of Beyond Fifth Generation (B5G) networks offers the infrastructure required to make these services a reality. We demonstrate a range of use cases, including emotional telemedicine, telesurgery, virtual physical therapy sessions, remote patient monitoring, and well-being monitoring, as we examine the possibilities of Metaverse-enabled Healthcare 5.0 in B5G networks. It is stated how these services can lead to better patient outcomes, more individualized treatment, and lower costs. In addition, we address the difficulties that these services present, including issues with data interoperability, privacy and security, and regulatory compliance, and we offer answers. Finally, we highlight future direction insights for metaverse-empowered healthcare5.0 in B5G networks.
